WHAT: Character spritesheet has 3 rows — row 0=down, row 1=up, row 2=right (mirror for left). Workers now use correct row based on facing direction.

WHERE: src/game/sprites.ts (drawCharacter), src/game/worker-entity.ts

HOW:
- FacingDir type: 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right'
- At desk: facing='up' (looking at screen = back to camera)
- Walking: facing updated each step based on dx/dy
- Idle animation: 2 frames with subtle Y offset for breathing effect
- ctx.scale(-1, 1) used to mirror right→left

WHY: More natural — workers look at their screens, walk in the direction they're moving
